authority: PHASE-020-J V1 SCOPE / WHOLE-SYSTEM COMPLETION / FINAL INTEGRATION-HARDENING DESIGN — DESIGN ONLY; NO G1/G2/G6/G7 AUTHORITY

v1_scope.adopted_product_variant: PF-01 — MUDAC Live Competition Judging & Official Outcome
required_capability_envelope: competitor establishment and bias-aware competition-facing identity/alias handling
Judge/Organizer Identity Participation Access and session realization
independent Scorecard Draft and authoritative Finalization
explicit ordinary or exceptional Outcome Declaration
operational deployment/backup/recovery/evidence infrastructure sufficient for release evaluation
explicit_non_goals: advanced Judge normalization/calibration as default core behavior
notification systems as required core functionality
rich public-results portal beyond controlled representation/release
unadopted product-family contractions or intentionally non-blinded judging
new semantic owners introduced solely for workflow convenience

integrated_journeys.name: competition preparation and blinded judging context
Judge entry, Draft, independent evaluation and Finalization
interruption, device, offline and paper continuity
Organizer live operations, incompletion and exceptions
outcome formation, recognition and official declaration
access revocation, privacy and technical support separation
deployment failure, restore and resumed digital authority

whole_system_criteria.title: PF-01 scope fidelity
whole_system_criteria.statement: The integrated system realizes PF-01's required capability envelope and does not introduce an unapproved non-goal or alternate product variant.

whole_system_criteria.title: Implementation package and dependency closure
whole_system_criteria.statement: Every 020-K retained V1-required package has a qualifying immutable G5 completion record; package hard/integration/evidence dependencies are closed or explicitly proven non-applicable.

whole_system_criteria.title: Purpose and semantic traceability
whole_system_criteria.statement: P-01..P-09, all eighteen PF-01 Concepts, applicable current policies/invariants and accepted architecture have implemented owners and exact traceability with no unexplained semantic gap.

whole_system_criteria.title: Integrated critical journeys
whole_system_criteria.statement: JNY-01..JNY-09 pass through the composed browser/API/persistence/provider boundaries applicable to each journey without semantic shortcuts.

whole_system_criteria.title: Fifteen-scenario composed replay
whole_system_criteria.statement: SCN-01..SCN-15 all have PASS evidence at their final composed material boundaries on the qualifying integrated candidate.

whole_system_criteria.title: Architecture and ownership conformance
whole_system_criteria.statement: All nine accepted architecture families remain satisfied; no reverse-authority path, owner-boundary contradiction or unapproved architecture change is present.

whole_system_criteria.title: Security, privacy and authority hardening
whole_system_criteria.statement: Integrated identity/access/disclosure, abuse, secrets, privilege and test-control boundaries pass applicable behavioral and supply-chain evidence without technical privilege becoming MUDAC authority.

whole_system_criteria.title: Migration, recovery and degraded continuity
whole_system_criteria.statement: The supported migration path, uncertain-command recovery, projection rebuild, backup restore and applicable DR/degraded paths preserve authority/history and are proven at the required evidence floors.

whole_system_criteria.title: Accessibility and responsive semantic parity
whole_system_criteria.statement: Critical Judge and Organizer flows meet the visible WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented semantic-parity contract with automated plus required manual evidence across representative consequential states.

whole_system_criteria.title: Performance, event-load and cost evidence
whole_system_criteria.statement: Visible performance/workload thresholds applicable to v1 pass on the declared environment; event-load behavior preserves semantic truth; material runtime costs and controls are evidenced without removing trust guarantees.

whole_system_criteria.title: Build, supply-chain and evidence integrity
whole_system_criteria.statement: The qualifying integrated candidate has reproducible exact-revision CI, required scanners, SBOM/provenance/attestation where applicable and one immutable whole-system evidence bundle.

whole_system_criteria.title: Knowledge, operations and residual-risk closure
whole_system_criteria.statement: Canonical/routing/operational documentation matches the qualifying revision; no known blocker remains hidden; every accepted non-blocking residual risk has owner and revisit gate.

purpose: qualify one composed v1 candidate rather than a collection of individually green packages
replay all program-level scenarios and integrated journeys
find boundary defects visible only after composition
produce the immutable whole-system implementation-completion evidence bundle
final_integration_hardening_phase.note_on_package_g5_and_hardening: The final phase may begin orchestration before the final evidence freeze as 020-K permits, but any source-changing fix to a package already at G5 follows 020-H reopen/re-authorization; V1-FINAL itself does not silently reopen package authority.
final_integration_hardening_phase.owned_or_declared_surfaces_rule: 020-K must explicitly declare integration-only surfaces. V1-FINAL has no blanket write authority over completed package-owned source.
permitted_work: release-candidate evidence assembly without granting G6
non-semantic operational hardening inside explicitly assigned surfaces
prohibited_work: direct modification of completed package-owned source without 020-H reopen/re-authorization
lowering visible criteria or evidence floors
production testing merely to obtain missing preproduction evidence

required_refs: accessibility evidence including manual critical-flow review
independent code and adversarial review records

v1_completion_state.meaning: PF-01 v1 implementation-program obligations are complete on one qualifying integrated revision.

anti_bloat_rules: final hardening is not a feature catch-all
do not activate explicit non-goals to make tests or architecture cleaner
do not introduce generic infrastructure without a v1 obligation
do not duplicate semantic rules in final-phase orchestration
do not redesign accepted architecture for aesthetic consistency
record non-required improvement as backlog/residual risk unless separately authorized
